cli_comprehensive_analysis.company_overview: Broadcom Inc. is a global technology leader in semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software, operating through four segments: Wired Infrastructure, Wireless Communications, Enterprise Storage, and Industrial & Other. The company serves diverse end markets including enterprise networking, data centers, telecommunications, smartphones, and industrial automation.

revenue_streams: Wired Infrastructure (enterprise and data center networking, Ethernet switching)
Wireless Communications (wireless access points, set-top boxes, cable/DSL equipment)
Enterprise Storage (data center servers and storage systems)
Industrial & Other (factory automation, power generation, electronic displays)

business_segments.wired_infrastructure: Enterprise and data center networking solutions, Ethernet switching, embedded processors for telecommunications
business_segments.wireless_communications: Wireless access points, set-top box SoCs, cable and DSL equipment for home connectivity
business_segments.enterprise_storage: Data center servers and storage systems with comprehensive software solutions
business_segments.industrial_other: Factory automation, power generation, alternative energy systems, electronic displays
